method: Specified deterministic starting geometry. All cases use the ordinary seeded RNG except shot-blocked-by-body, which fixes the random draw to 0.5 for a centred contact-path strike. Keeper handling/reactions are explicitly set alongside their selected overall values since stage11. Field delivery cases execute the real kick windup/release, then fixed-body BallPhysics/ballStep at 60Hz; keeper cases begin with a specified incoming flight and execute ordinary Match.step visibility/reaction/hands/custody. The centred-strike RNG override is the only method override; no player relocation during flight or direct event/counter writes occurs. Two complete own Match states, including RNG, are deeply compared per fixture; immutable motion module is separately source-hashed.

definitions.opportunity: Counts are explicit fixture inputs or geometric contact windows, not representative natural frequencies. Distinct cross/body pairs in the real descending 1.60–2.15m contact window are counted once, separately from released crosses and actual headers. Ground contact approaches are geometry plus existing clocks; they do not imply feasible possession.
definitions.keeper: Geometric threat uses the real initial ball trajectory to the goal plane. Opponent-shot and own-backpass fixtures are separate. Save events distinguish custody from parry; specified incoming flights are not counted as executed shots. The fast-catch trial uses the real rig two-hand model; other keeper trials use the existing fallback single hand.
definitions.limits: Selected positive and negative fixtures establish path coverage only. Counts and denominators must not be converted to natural conversion/save rates or evidence that aerial/keeper quality is balanced. Fixed-body free-flight tests do not verify tactical runs, whole matches, fatigue or animation quality.
